get.summary: Orgs the user can switch to in the token's app

put.summary: Enable an app for an org

delete.summary: Disable an app for an org (revokes its grants)

put.summary: Upload or replace an org's login logo (PNG, JPEG or WebP, max 512 KB)

post.summary: Create an app; the plaintext clientSecret is returned only here
Rotate the client secret; the new plaintext is returned only here
Add a permission to an app's catalog

delete.summary: Remove a permission from the catalog (and from the app's roles)

get.summary: List an app's roles with their permissions

put.summary: Replace a role's permissions (each must be in the app's catalog)

post.summary: Create a user with a temporary password (must change at first sign-in)
Set a temporary password for any user (must change at next sign-in); ends their grants and sessions

get.summary: Full activity log, newest first; filter by org, action and time range
List/search the org's members with their roles

post.summary: Create a user with a temporary password and add them to the org
Add an existing user to the org by email

delete.summary: Remove a member from the org (and end their grants for it)

post.summary: Set a temporary password (only for users whose every membership is in this org)

put.summary: Set a member's roles (replaces them); each role's app must be enabled for the org

get.summary: The org's activity log, newest first; filter by action and time range

put.summary: Upload or replace the org's login logo (PNG, JPEG or WebP, max 512 KB)
